description: Predator-matrix seed for T6 (bioforms foundry). Curated, FishBase-grounded predator-prey-defense records. ropensci FishBase API is DNS-blocked in sandbox; fishbase.se reachable (species pages) for expansion. Each record: prey defense mapped to a bioform family; predator countermeasure class; observed outcome; source.
scaling_path: expand via fishbase.se species pages (Predators table per species) into this schema; target n>=100 for stable T6 accuracy; then re-run scripts/validate_bioforms_v2.py

schema.prey_defense_form_ids: archive form ids instantiating the defense

records.mechanism: drilling radula neutralizes gape-limitation; the classic armor counter-specialist (Vermeij 1987)
records.source: FishBase invert records; Vermeij, Evolution and Escalation (1987)

records.mechanism: rigid carapace exceeds gape and swallowing capacity; boxfish persist in high-predation reefs
records.source: FishBase Ostracion; Tu et al. 2020 (carapace biomechanics)

records.mechanism: spines raise handling cost above handling profit for generalists
crushing jaws/specialists defeat spines; urchin fronts track specialist absence
confusion and dilution effects; predators still feed, capture rate per attack drops
records.source: FishBase; Krause & Ruxton, Living in Groups (2002)

records.mechanism: partial predation absorbed by module redundancy; colony survives module loss
records.source: FishBase; Jackson 1979 (colonial vs solitary defensive economics)

records.mechanism: thick scaled skin shields turtles from nematocysts; the bell's defense is specialist-limited
jet burst escape raises pursuit cost but is outrun at sustained speed
carcinization's flat, wide, armored form resists swallowing; Wolfe et al. link crab form to gape-limited predation
records.source: FishBase; Wolfe et al. 2021 (carcinization and predation)

records.mechanism: maneuverability in crevices offsets ambush; not immunity
records.source: FishBase; Webb 1984 (body form and escape performance)

records.mechanism: structural camouflage disrupts detection; fails against chemical/tactile hunters
records.source: FishBase; Matchette et al. 2018 (camouflage in changing environments)

records.mechanism: speed and endurance raise pursuit cost; specialist pursuit still succeeds
records.source: FishBase; Blank et al. 2007 ( scombrid performance)

records.mechanism: rigid body + eversion response; specialists (triton snails) counter
armor defeated by bite-force specialists; generalist gape excluded
architecture and module redundancy limit grazer damage; chronic scraping still shapes colony form
